page=canvas(size=(220 mm,180 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")

p=plot(size=(110 mm,90 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 15 mm), size=(70 mm, 50 mm)),style=s,x=axis(range=(0,3)),y=axis(range=(0,3)))
